Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 18
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator fabricated an unverified list of 1959 “dehydrated” and “frozen” items and misapplied the inclusion criteria instead of extracting the actual items from the 1959 standards. This flawed baseline led to using placeholder/simulated counts rather than real supersession data, causing the downstream calculation to yield the wrong percentage (38% instead of the correct 86%).
